name: researcher
description: One research agent that does its own analysis, keeps a memory, and writes pages you read in the Reader tab: what waits for you, what you accepted, and a logbook of the work.
greeting:
Researcher: one research agent with a memory.

Run `claude` or `pi` here, whichever this project carries. The agent does its
own analysis in this container, on the data folders you gave the project, and
keeps its own memory under /workspace/memory/. Read what it has for you in the
Reader tab: README.md, the front page (what waits for you, what is running,
where things stand, what is known); staging/, the claims waiting for you;
results/, what you accepted; logbook/, the story of the work, one entry per
topic, written when you type /log. The agent writes these pages; do not edit
them.

A finding enters the record only when you accept it: say "accept F-3".
